Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retire this provider-specific benchmark/optimization task from ScalaFIM scheduling. Its exact subject is mesh4s dfcb875 plus locus4s eec9a4b, strict topology/SurfaceRealization construction and mesh4s laws. Current build has no mesh4s dependency; ScalaFIM SurfaceGeometry uses local TriangleMesh and image4s Affine, so the measured execution path is not the current core path. The issue has no dependencies or dependents. The generic provider implementation/laws belong upstream, and preserving this unadopted candidate task as an open ScalaFIM obligation does not advance current core stabilization.

Close as retired-upstream, not fixed: retain the measured allocations, generated-grid dimensions and exact candidate identities as historical evidence. No upstream implementation, issue transfer, current benchmark pass or provider publication is claimed. If a future adopted consumer exposes this cost, reopen a bounded integration issue against its exact pins and measured current input, rather than importing old budgets blindly. Current surface nearest-vertex work remains open in bd-01M0TGTH208WXGQ2CZJZM7RWRQ with a current coordinate-lifetime contract. This assessment changes tracking only.
